  • Method Details

    • getDragPoint

      public org.jogamp.vecmath.Point3f getDragPoint(org.jogamp.vecmath.Point3f ret)
      While dragging, the dragPoint points to the coordinates of a point in the same plane as the picked object, but under the current cusor position. REMINDER -- this method hard-codes the 3D drag policy described above. The implementation might better be made pluggable.
      Returns:
      the point where the object was dragged to
